comment: The probe runs from GitHub Actions runners — outside the droplet — so an edge/proxy/DNS
failure that leaves the in-stack Prometheus scrapes green is still detected.
expectStatus lists every status that counts as up (redirects are fine for the web app);
maxLatencyMs is the committed per-request latency budget.
Override the whole list per run (dispatch input `targets`) or for all runs with the
UPTIME_PROBE_TARGETS repository variable (same shape as `targets` below).
Set UPTIME_PROBE_ENABLED=false to pause the schedule during a known outage.
Note: api.mainecybertech.com is served by the legacy AWS ALB/ECS deployment
(docs/PRODUCTION_VS_TESTING_DOMAINS.md) and currently returns 404 for /health; the probe
reports it until the prod deploy path (CI-P1-003) lands. Do not remove the target — a
green run is the signal the prod API is finally healthy.
